messages:
jamal-recruiter: FYI: panel at 3pm (Platform Eng) — interviewers saying they didn't receive the scorecard link in the calendar invite. Candidates still waiting on feedback.

sarah-peopleops: Which candidate ID? can you paste the calendar invite id?

jamal-recruiter: C-2198, invite id invite-3b2. Calendar description blank except 'Interview with Redwood'.

maria-hiringops: Looking at ATS logs: scorecard entity exists, but calendar sync returned 202 then 409 for invite-3b2.

ats-bot: ats-bot: webhook delivery failed: 409 Conflict - mapping_exists (delivery_id=fc9a2)

kevin-intops: Likely race where enrich-on-create ran twice after we toggled the flag last night. Quick mitigation: will push a transient patch that appends scorecard URL to invite bodies if enrichment not confirmed within 25s.

jamal-recruiter: Can you also surface a marker in ATS UI for invites missing scorecards? makes it easier for recruiters to triage.

sarah-peopleops: Agreed. For now recruiting can send a manual reminder once patch is live. Maria, can you verify training badges too? some interviewers reported their "trained" status missing on roster.

maria-hiringops: Will audit upcoming panels and ping folks. Training writes are separate webhook events; possible stale cache read.

kevin-intops: Patch deployed; logs show retry succeeded and invite-3b2 body now contains https://ats.redwood/proc/C-2198/scorecard

maria-hiringops: Confirmed on calendar. I messaged panel and asked them to re-open invite to see link.

jamal-recruiter: Thanks. Please leave a note in the interview ops playbook and add an oncall checklist to check for calendar 409s.

sarah-peopleops: I'll prioritize a dashboard for 'invite enrichment failures' in the next sprint. Also we'll make the training flag read strongly consistent for roster.

kevin-intops: I'll produce a short postmortem and add a sticky summary here once I finish tracing the event ordering.

jamal-recruiter: Great, appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
